title: For each IPv4 subnet name that also has at least one DNS nameserver entry,
question: For each IPv4 subnet name that also has at least one DNS nameserver entry, return the subnet name along with the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of (1) the number of routes per subnet and (2) the number of IP allocation pools per subnet. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible_subnets AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.name
  FROM subnets s
  WHERE s.ip_version = 4
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM dnsnameservers d
      WHERE d.subnet_id = s.id
    )
),
route_counts AS (
  SELECT e.name AS subnet_name, COUNT(sr.destination) AS route_count
  FROM eligible_subnets e
  LEFT JOIN subnetroutes sr ON sr.subnet_id = e.id
  GROUP BY e.name
),
pool_counts AS (
  SELECT e.name AS subnet_name, COUNT(p.id) AS pool_count
  FROM eligible_subnets e
  LEFT JOIN ipallocationpools p ON p.subnet_id = e.id
  GROUP BY e.name
)
SELECT rc.subnet_name AS subnet_name,
       MAX(rc.route_count) - MIN(rc.route_count) AS route_range,
       VARIANCE(rc.route_count) AS route_variance,
       STDDEV(rc.route_count) AS route_stddev,
       MAX(pc.pool_count) - MIN(pc.pool_count) AS pool_range,
       VARIANCE(pc.pool_count) AS pool_variance,
       STDDEV(pc.pool_count) AS pool_stddev
FROM route_counts rc
JOIN pool_counts pc ON rc.subnet_name = pc.subnet_name
GROUP BY rc.subnet_name;

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN (SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM `subnetroutes` AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC) SELECT s.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, COUNT(sr.DESTINATION) AS total_routes, MAX(inner_cte.route_count_range) AS route_count_range, MAX(inner_cte.route_count_variance) AS route_count_variance, MAX(inner_cte.route_count_stddev) AS route_count_stddev FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `subnetroutes` AS sr ON s.ID = sr.SUBNET_ID JOIN inner_cte ON inner_cte.subnet_name = s.NAME WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.TENANT_ID ORDER BY total_routes DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`ORDER`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`ORDER`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`ORDER`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT inner_cte.subnet_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS ip_allocation_pool_count FROM inner_cte JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.name = inner_cte.subnet_name JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id WHERE inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation > 0.5 GROUP BY inner_cte.subnet_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DnsOrderStats AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, AVG(d.`ORDER`) AS avg_dns_order, VARIANCE(d.`ORDER`) AS dns_order_variance FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON s.ID = d.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY dns_order_variance DESC), RoutePoolDetails AS (SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM `subnetroutes` AS r JOIN `subnets` AS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4) SELECT rpd.subnet_name, rpd.subnet_cidr, rpd.DESTINATION, rpd.NEXTHOP, rpd.FIRST_IP, rpd.LAST_IP, rpd.window_column, dos.avg_dns_order, dos.dns_order_variance FROM RoutePoolDetails AS rpd JOIN DnsOrderStats AS dos ON rpd.subnet_name = dos.subnet_name ORDER BY dos.dns_order_variance DESC, rpd.subnet_name, rpd.window_column), VarianceBenchmark AS (SELECT AVG(dns_order_variance) AS avg_dns_order_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.subnet_cidr, i.DESTINATION, i.NEXTHOP, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.window_column, i.avg_dns_order, i.dns_order_variance, vb.avg_dns_order_variance AS benchmark_dns_order_variance, CASE WHEN i.dns_order_variance > vb.avg_dns_order_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.dns_order_variance < vb.avg_dns_order_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN VarianceBenchmark AS vb ORDER BY i.dns_order_variance DESC, i.subnet_name, i.window_column

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`order`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`order`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT r.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`order`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT inner_cte.subnet_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, avg_cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) AS avg_cv ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`order`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`order`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT r.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`order`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.name = i.subnet_name WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT q1.subnet_name, q1.coefficient_of_variation, q1.avg_coefficient_of_variation, q2.coefficient_of_variation AS above_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.subnet_name = q1.subnet_name ORDER BY q1.coefficient_of_variation DESC

WITH base AS (
  SELECT s.name,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subnetroutes r WHERE r.subnet_id = s.id) AS route_cnt,

  FROM subnets s
  WHERE s.ip_version = 4
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dnsnameservers d WHERE d.subnet_id = s.id)
)
SELECT name,
       MAX(route_cnt)-MIN(route_cnt) AS route_range,
       VARIANCE(route_cnt) AS route_var,
       STDDEV(route_cnt) AS route_std,
       MAX(pool_cnt)-MIN(pool_cnt) AS pool_range,
       VARIANCE(pool_cnt) AS pool_var,
       STDDEV(pool_cnt) AS pool_std
FROM base
GROUP BY name;
